messages:
marta: Heads-up: scheduling a focussed retest for the inference cluster next Thu 09:00-10:30 UTC. need final checks for RBAC diffs, KMS snapshots, and audit export cadence. who can take ownership?

drew: Ill take RBAC diff + ephemeral role setup. will prepare policy that limits s3 prefix access and k8s view-only rights.

sam: Ill handle audit exports: cloudtrail + k8s audit logs, plus smoke test logs. will gzip and provide sha256 manifests.

marta: please include exact commands and run-ids in manifests. put everything under s3://redwood-pt-evidence/acme-mini-retest/manifests/. name files like resource-20260331T090000Z.json

drew: ephemeral role: 1h duration, assume via sts; restrict by corp & assessor IP list. sample: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-ephemeral-inference --duration-seconds 3600` will include session id in manifest.

oncall-sre: add small extension policy: request via infra/pt-requests PR; auto-grant if both approvers sign within 10m.

sam: KMS plan: export DescribeKey, key policy, rotation status + timestamp. place under /kms/ and reference key-id in manifest.

marta: create a single triage_owner field in manifest. action items: drew=RBAC PR, sam=log uploads, marta=final manifest + close ticket. post s3 links here when done.

security-bot: Jira created SEC-PT-4602 assigned drew,sam,marta https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/SEC-PT-4602
